studyArea.label: Bounded grid pipeline demonstration near the Atacama region

scientificLimitations: This single-cell area is a pipeline demonstration, not a selected discovery region or claim of a new analog.
The bounding box is adjacent to a known Atacama analog region; a configurable 75 km exclusion around known reference coordinates does not guarantee geological independence.
The generated grid center is a sampling coordinate for one coarse cell and not a field site.
